description: Unit tests for the NTLM HTTP authentication handler, specifically testing the portable NTLM implementation in Chromium's net module.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerNtlmPortableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for NTLM HTTP authentication handler tests, including setup and utility functions.

methods.name: CreateHandler
methods.description: Creates an NTLM auth handler for testing.

methods.name: CreateNtlmAuthHeader
methods.description: Encodes a buffer into an NTLM authorization header string.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Handles an NTLM challenge string and returns the result.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token using the auth handler.

methods.name: ReadBytesPayload
methods.description: Reads bytes from a NTLM buffer reader into a span.

methods.name: ReadStringPayload
methods.description: Reads bytes from a NTLM buffer reader into a string.

methods.name: ReadString16Payload
methods.description: Reads bytes from a NTLM buffer reader into a UTF-16 string.

methods.name: GetGenerateAuthTokenResult
methods.description: Helper to generate auth token and get result code.

methods.name: GetAuthHandler
methods.description: Returns the current NTLM auth handler.

methods.name: MockRandom
methods.description: Mocks randomness for testing, fills output with 0xaa.
